consequence.statement: No operational consequence for an operator: the bump only changes a version of a GitHub Actions dependency pinned in the repository's own workflows and does not alter anything shipped to or run in a customer environment.

assertion.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 bumps the crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg GitHub Actions dependency used in the project's own workflows from 6.2.0 to 6.3.0, a CI-only dependency update with no operator-facing effect.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence only records a dependabot version bump of a GitHub Actions dependency (crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg) used in the project's own CI workflows; it names no state of a customer environment from which an exposure condition could be derived.
